raw/openaq.source: OpenAQ API v3 /locations and /sensors/{id}/days, PM2.5 and CO, stripped to [date, value, observedCount] (draft 1 extract; kept for the station list and CO)

raw/openaq_hours.source: OpenAQ API v3 /sensors/{id}/hours, 1 Oct-31 Jan of seasons 2016-17 to 2022-23, as [from, to, value, observedCount, expectedCount]

raw/openaq_days_full.source: OpenAQ API v3 /sensors/{id}/days, complete records (period, coverage, summary, flags), gzip

raw/openaq_probe.source: OpenAQ API v3 complete responses for three sample station-days (days, hours, measurements)

raw/firms.source: NASA FIRMS area API, MODIS_SP (2001-2025) and MODIS_NRT (2026), box 73.0,27.0,79.5,32.6, 1 Oct-30 Nov

raw/era5.source: Open-Meteo archive API, ERA5, 28.61N 77.21E, hourly, 1980-2026, Asia/Kolkata

raw/windgrid.source: Open-Meteo archive API, ERA5 100 m wind, 0.5 degree grid 27.5-33N 72.5-78.5E, UTC

raw/windouter.source: Open-Meteo archive API, ERA5 100 m wind, 1 degree grid 24-35N 69-83E, UTC

raw/sat.source: NASA GIBS WMS image tiles: VIIRS NOAA-20 true colour and MODIS MAIAC AOD with its colour map (NOT in the ZIP: 16 MB; only the exploratory AOD check and the animation need them)
